landing.headline: Lost something? It may already be waiting for you.
landing.lead: Report what you lost or found with one photo. Eureka compares it with every report nearby and tells you both when there's a match.
landing.step1Body: Add a photo, the place and the day. Eureka reads the details from the photo for you.
landing.step2Body: It looks for reports of the same object nearby and compares the photos side by side.
landing.step3Body: When you both agree it's the same item, chat and arrange the handover.
landing.exampleCaption: Two reports, tied together with the reasons Eureka found.
landing.exampleReason1: Same torn corner at the bottom left
landing.exampleReason2: Initials N.B. embossed on the front
